transcript.content: Cluster 304's top up-regulated markers are: apoc1, mespaa, mespab, meox1, apoeb, pcdh8, msgn1, fstl1a. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Presomitic/paraxial mesoderm progenitor — somitogenesis/segmental-plate state.**

## Evidence
- **msgn1** — expressed in segmental plate, tail bud, margin/paraxial mesoderm; fits posterior presomitic mesoderm progenitors [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030722-1/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030722-1/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **mespaa** — expressed in presumptive paraxial mesoderm, segmental plate, paraxial mesoderm and somite; supports anterior PSM/somitogenesis identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000406-8/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000406-8/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **mespab** — acts in somite rostral/caudal axis specification and somite specification; expressed in mesoderm and somite [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-090817-2). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-090817-2?utm_source=openai))
- **meox1** — WT expression includes segmental plate, paraxial mesoderm and somite, consistent with somitic/paraxial mesoderm [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-149/expression). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-149/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **fstl1a** — expressed in mesoderm/mesenchyme and somite; supportive but less specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4148). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-4148?utm_source=openai))
- **segmental plate** — ZFA synonym “presomitic mesoderm”; unsegmented paraxial mesoderm posterior to the newest somite pair, from which somites form [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000279). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0000279?utm_source=openai))
- **paraxial mesoderm development** — GO term covers progression of paraxial mesoderm, located bilaterally adjacent to notochord/neural tube [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0048339). ([amigo.geneontology.org](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0048339?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **apoc1/apoeb** can mark lipid/microglial programs, but the dominant mespaa/mespab/msgn1/meox1 axis is embryonic PSM.

**Verdict:** presomitic/paraxial mesoderm progenitor, progenitor — confidence high

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Most defensible: presomitic/paraxial mesoderm progenitors; alternative microglia/lipid-handling cells is weaker and likely driven by apolipoprotein markers.**

## Evidence
- **mespaa** — expressed in presumptive paraxial mesoderm, segmental plate, paraxial mesoderm, and somite; function includes gastrulation/regionalization → strongest mesoderm call [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000406-8). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-000406-8/expression?utm_source=openai))
- **mespab** — expressed in margin/mesoderm/post-vent region/somite; acts in somite rostral/caudal axis specification and somite specification [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-090817-2). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-090817-2?utm_source=openai))
- **msgn1** — expressed in margin, mesoderm, tail bud, myoblast; acts in paraxial mesodermal cell differentiation and somatic muscle development [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030722-1). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030722-1?utm_source=openai))
- **pcdh8.1/pcdh8** — “paraxial protocadherin”; expressed in margin/mesoderm/presumptive mesoderm, supporting adhesion/morphogenesis rather than mature immune identity [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-242). ([zfin.org](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-242?utm_source=openai))
- **meox1** — mutant phenotypes affect vertebral/somite-derived skeleton; this supports somite/paraxial derivatives but not a mature sclerotome call alone [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-149). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040718-149?utm_source=openai))
- **apoc1/apoeb** — alternative microglia/lipid hypothesis: apoeb is expressed in hematopoietic cells/nervous system and apoc1/apoeb are reported in zebrafish microglia, but this conflicts with the Mesp/Msgn axis [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-211211-12). ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-980526-368?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier is **tissue/progenitor domain**, not a mature cell type.
- Apolipoproteins add ambiguity, but are outweighed by coherent paraxial/presomitic markers.

**Verdict:** presomitic/paraxial mesoderm progenitor — confidence high
